subject: Pilot stipend reclassification and invoice offset request - Pegasus AI
content:
From: Lisa Barton <lisa.barton@pegasus.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.inference
Cc: procurement@pegasus.ai
Date: Mon, 09 May 2027 16:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: pilot stipend reclassification + invoice offset

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the Redwood pilot — the team found the runtime numbers really promising. Finance reached out this morning with two asks so we can close out the pilot cleanly on our side:

1) Can Redwood provide a credit memo for the $12,500 pilot stipend so we can net it against our final invoice?
2) Our accounting team needs suggested G/L mapping for how Redwood recommends we record the credit (promo allowance vs expense offset) and whether we should treat it as a contra-revenue or a contra-expense.

Attached are the signed pilot SOW and the final usage invoice. Ideally we can get the draft credit memo and GL guidance by EOD Wednesday so our controller can post it before month-end.

Thanks,
Lisa Barton
CFO, Pegasus AI
[attachment: pegasus_pilot_agreement.pdf (PDF)]
[attachment: invoice_7891_pegasus.pdf (PDF)]

---

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.inference
To: Lisa Barton <lisa.barton@pegasus.ai>
Cc: marus_lin@redwood.inference, neha_kapoor@redwood.inference, procurement@pegasus.ai
Date: Tue, 10 May 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: pilot stipend reclassification + invoice offset

Lisa — appreciate the fast turnaround. I looped in Marcus and Neha from Finance so we can give a clear accounting recommendation and produce the draft credit memo.

Short answers up front:
- We can issue a $12,500 credit memo referencing Invoice #7891 and the pilot SOW.
- Our standard recommendation for these one-off pilot stipends is to record the credit as a contra-revenue (reduction to gross revenue) on the customer side, with a matching expense classification on Redwood’s books as a sales promotion/stipend.

Marcus / Neha — can you confirm the recommended COA mapping and whether Pegasus should net the credit against the invoice or post a separate memo? I attached a draft credit memo and a suggested COA mapping spreadsheet for review.

Next steps:
- Marcus to confirm GL lines and journal entry template.
- I’ll produce a final credit memo PDF that references DEAL-2024-0912 and the HubSpot deal link.

Thanks — Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[attachment: draft_credit_memo_pegasus_20270512.pdf (PDF)]
[attachment: coa_mapping_suggestion.xlsx (XLSX)]

---

From: marcus_lin@redwood.inference
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.inference, Lisa Barton <lisa.barton@pegasus.ai>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.inference, procurement@pegasus.ai
Date: Wed, 11 May 2027 10:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: pilot stipend reclassification + invoice offset

Karthik / Lisa — quick finance note with an operational recommendation.

1) Recommended Pegasus posting (external/bookkeeping view):
   - Record the $12,500 as a contra-revenue line on the customer receivable (reduce the outstanding AR tied to Invoice #7891). This makes month-end reporting clearer for revenue recognition.

2) Redwood internal posting (our books):
   - Redwood will record the outflow as Sales & Marketing Promotions (GL 6200) and book a corresponding reduction to revenue upon credit memo issuance.

3) Journal entry template we suggest for Pegasus:
   - Debit: Sales Returns & Allowances (contra-revenue) — $12,500
   - Credit: Accounts Receivable — $12,500

If Pegasus prefers to keep the credit as a separate memo (not netted), they can post a memo and leave AR untouched, but that could complicate revenue reporting for month-end close.

Action items:
- Karthik: finalize the credit memo PDF with a reference to DEAL-2024-0912 and upload to DocuSign if necessary.
- Neha: can you validate the COA mapping in the attached spreadsheet and confirm Redwood's netting language?

Marcus Lin
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
[signature]

---

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.inference
To: marcus_lin@redwood.inference, karthik_iyer@redwood.inference, Lisa Barton <lisa.barton@pegasus.ai>
Cc: procurement@pegasus.ai
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: pilot stipend reclassification + invoice offset

Following up — I reviewed the COA mapping and we’re good with Marcus’s recommendation. A few operational notes for Pegasus:

- If you net the $12,500 on Invoice #7891, please include a line item on the remittance advice that states: "Redwood pilot stipend credit — referencing Credit Memo CM-20270512 and Invoice #7891" so your AR system can automatically reconcile.
- If your ERP requires a different GL code, let us know the exact mapping and we'll produce a variant credit memo.
- We attached a clean credit memo PDF for signature.

Lisa — attaching final credit memo and the suggested COA mapping (spreadsheet). Once you confirm, I’ll ask accounting ops to create CM-20270512 in our system and send the signed copy.

Thanks — Neha
Senior Accounting Associate, Redwood Inference
